name: court-notice-plain-language
title: Court notice → plain-language public notice

title_i18n.zh-CN: 法院文书 → 通俗易懂的公告

description: Transform a court document — eviction summons, restraining order, subpoena — into a one-page bilingual (English + Spanish) plain-language public notice in the road-work warning-sign visual language. Extracts every date, case number, party name, and address character-for-character from the source PDF, then renders an A4 print-ready page a panicking reader can act on in 30 seconds.

description_i18n.en: Transform a court document — eviction summons, restraining order, subpoena — into a one-page bilingual (English + Spanish) plain-language public notice in the road-work warning-sign visual language. Extracts every date, case number, party name, and address character-for-character from the source PDF, then renders an A4 print-ready page a panicking reader can act on in 30 seconds.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把法院文书（驱逐通知、限制令、传票等）转换成一页双语（英文 + 西班牙文）的通俗易懂公告，采用施工警示牌视觉语言。日期、案号、当事人姓名、地址一律按原文字字逐字提取，输出可直接打印为 A4 PDF。

query.en: I'm attaching a court document. Transform it into a one-page plain-language public notice (English + Spanish) in the road-work warning-sign style — saturated yellow, three inks, heavy condensed signage type, the date as the largest element, three numbered action steps with black pictograms, and a verbatim zone listing case number / dates / court / parties exactly as they appear in the source.
query.zh-CN: 我附了一份法院文书。请把它转换成一页通俗易懂的公告（英文 + 西班牙文），采用施工警示牌风格——饱和黄底、三种墨色、重磅 condensed 标牌字体、日期作为页面上最大元素、三个带黑色象形图的编号步骤，并在底部列出原文逐字提取的案号、日期、法院、当事人。

inputs.name: courtDocument
inputs.label: Court document
inputs.placeholder: Attach the eviction summons, restraining order, subpoena, or other court paper (PDF / DOCX / image).

inputs.name: audienceNotes
inputs.label: Audience notes
inputs.placeholder: Optional: limited-English readers, panicking parent, posting at apartment door, etc.

inputs.name: secondLanguage
inputs.label: Second language
inputs.placeholder: Defaults to Spanish. Override with the language code (es, vi, zh, etc.) of the second page.
